tables.description: Auth: Audit trail for user actions.
Stores metadata for all OAuth/SSO login flows
Auth: Stores identities associated to a user.
Auth: Manages users across multiple sites.
auth: stores authenticator method reference claims for multi factor authentication
auth: stores metadata about challenge requests made
auth: stores metadata about factors
Stores OAuth states for third-party provider authentication flows where Supabase acts as the OAuth client.
Auth: Store of tokens used to refresh JWT tokens once they expire.
Auth: Manages SAML Identity Provider connections.
Auth: Contains SAML Relay State information for each Service Provider initiated login.
Auth: Manages updates to the auth system.
Auth: Stores session data associated to a user.
Auth: Manages SSO email address domain mapping to an SSO Identity Provider.
Auth: Manages SSO identity provider information; see saml_providers for SAML.
Auth: Stores user login data within a secure schema.
Backward compatibility view pointing to public.identities.
Catalog of capability permissions for admin portal features.
Razorpay one-time addon purchases; credits applied to user_addons after payment capture.
Add-on catalog: unit prices; user purchases stored in user_addons when that table exists.
Outbound email delivery records (transactional and campaign).
Platform-wide suppression list. Prevents any tenant from sending to known hard-bouncing or spam-complaining mailboxes.
Connected email identities (Google Workspace, SMTP inboxes, and verified domain relay senders).
Maps user_id to pg_cron job mailofly_umq_* that fires every minute to drain pending emails.
Billing plan catalog (tiers, limits, features). Editable from admin.
Backward compatibility view pointing to public.identities.
Audit log of raw Amazon SES notification events received via SNS webhook.
Per-tenant/organization email suppression list (unsubscribes, bounces, complaints, manual blocks).
One row per onboarding survey question per user; keyed for analytics queries.
Table with encrypted `secret` column for storing sensitive information on disk.

constraints.definition: CHECK (((provider_type <> 'oauth2'::text) OR ((authorization_url IS NOT NULL) AND (token_url IS NOT NULL) AND (userinfo_url IS NOT NULL))))

CASE

    ELSE false
END)))
